query: select p.user_id, p.display_name, p.registration_seq, p.created_at, is_hidden from profiles p left join global_community_profiles gcp on gcp.user_id = p.user_id where p.user_id in (bot_ids)
conclusion: both accounts are the #1 and #2 results of GET /api/v1/community/members?sort=newest (the default sort), unfiltered before this fix
